raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

The rejection sampler draws the final token in the same program as the acceptance decision. With a large vocabulary and few requests, this leaves much of the GPU idle. This change splits the residual draw across vocabulary blocks.

## Modifications

Keep acceptance decisions in the existing kernel, then compute residual masses for 4,096-token vocabulary blocks, select a block and draw the final token. Token-wise and block verification use the same implementation; the sampler API is unchanged. FP32 summation order changes, so a draw can differ near a CDF rounding boundary while representing the same distribution.

PR #42615 changes the draft-probability range check in the same code. Whichever lands second must preserve that update.

## Accuracy Tests

A focused block-verification reference check passes on the updated branch on an RTX 5070 Ti (SM120), both on CUDA and under the Triton interpreter. Earlier GPU validation covered both verification modes, distribution behavior and CUDA graph replay. Acceptance decisions matched the base; final-token differences were limited to FP32 CDF boundaries and remained within reference tolerance. That full matrix has not been repeated on this commit.

Earlier B200 validation used branch revision 5e9bfa815b over a main nightly, before the latest base update. Accept lengths matched the base, and the few final-token differences were at float32 CDF boundaries. The SM120 AOT wheel mismatch prevented DSpark runtime integration checks there. Full model accuracy remains unverified.

Run the speculative kernel suites with `python -m pytest` in a compatible CUDA environment or through the registered CI runner.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

The earlier B200 validation used a GLM-5.3-Flash FP8 model with EAGLE 4/1/5 and a 154,880-token vocabulary. In an isolated CUDA-graph sampler benchmark, the block draw was 4.7x to 8.8x faster across the measured request counts and acceptance patterns. The server A/B switched the kernel in process and measured time per verify step:

| Streams | Main | This change | Reduction |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 1 | 8.414 ms | 8.378 ms | 36 us (0.43%) |
| 4 | 12.091 ms | 12.048 ms | 44 us (0.36%) |
| 16 | 18.334 ms | 18.273 ms | 60 us (0.33%) |

These measurements used revision 5e9bfa815b and predate the latest base update. They have not been rerun on the updated branch. The server comparison used one server with interleaved passes; main server runs varied by up to about 0.33% at higher concurrency, so the end-to-end changes are modest. Block verification in a server, TP8, other GPUs and full model accuracy remain unvalidated.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

+    TargetProbs,
+    DraftProbs,
+    ResidualScale,
+    pid,
+    num_accept,

+    stride_tp_b,
+    stride_tp_s,

+    VOCAB_SIZE: tl.constexpr,

+    # accepted, else from the residual max(residual_scale * p - q, 0).
+    mask = v_offsets < VOCAB_SIZE

+        TargetProbs

+        + num_accept * stride_tp_s
+        + v_offsets * stride_tp_v,

+        other=0.0,

+            + num_accept * stride_dp_s
+            + v_offsets * stride_dp_v,
+            mask=mask,
+            other=0.0,
+        )
+        # Treat any non-probability q (NaN, +-inf, negative) as 0: the
+        # residual falls back to p. A comparison against NaN is false, so
+        # the range test rejects it along with the infinities.
+        q_val = tl.where((q_val >= 0.0) & (q_val <= 1.0), q_val, 0.0)
+        diff = tl.load(ResidualScale + pid) * p_val - q_val
+        val = tl.where(diff > 0.0, diff, 0.0)

+    # One program per (request, vocabulary block): the weight of the block.
+    pid = tl.program_id(0)
+    block = tl.program_id(1)

+@triton.jit
+def _final_token_kernel(
+    Predicts,
+    AcceptTokenNum,
+    RetriveIndex,
+    UniformSamplesFinal,
+    ResidualScale,
+    TargetProbs,
+    DraftProbs,
+    BlockSums,
+    stride_idx_b,
+    stride_idx_s,
+    stride_tp_b,
+    stride_tp_s,
+    stride_tp_v,
+    stride_dp_b,
+    stride_dp_s,
+    stride_dp_v,
+    num_blocks,
+    NUM_SLOTS: tl.constexpr,
+    VOCAB_SIZE: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_V: tl.constexpr,
+    NUM_BLOCKS_POW2: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    # Inverse-CDF draw: the block sums locate the block where the CDF passes
+    # coin_final * total, then a cumsum inside that block locates the token.
+    pid = tl.program_id(0)
+    num_accept = tl.load(AcceptTokenNum + pid)
+    blocks = tl.arange(0, NUM_BLOCKS_POW2)
+    block_sums = tl.load(
+        BlockSums + pid * num_blocks + blocks, mask=blocks < num_blocks, other=0.0
+    )
+    block_cdf = tl.cumsum(block_sums, axis=0)
+    target_u = tl.load(UniformSamplesFinal + pid) * tl.max(block_cdf, axis=0)
+    crossed = (block_cdf > target_u) & (block_sums > 0.0)
 
-    # Pass 2: CDF. Degenerate residual (norm_sum == 0, i.e. p == q everywhere on

-    # VOCAB_SIZE - 1; acceptable since this case is numerically near-impossible.
-    target_u = coin_final * norm_sum
-    cum_sum = 0.0
+    # Degenerate residual (total == 0, i.e. p == q everywhere on rejection)
+    # crosses no block, so final_token falls back to VOCAB_SIZE - 1; acceptable
+    # since this case is numerically near-impossible.
     final_token = VOCAB_SIZE - 1
-    found = 0
-
-    for v_start in range(0, VOCAB_SIZE, BLOCK_V):

-            mask = v_offsets < VOCAB_SIZE
-
-            p_ptr = tp_base_ptr + v_offsets * stride_tp_v

-

-                diff = residual_scale * p_val - q_val

-
-            block_cumsum = tl.cumsum(val, axis=0)
-            total_cumsum = cum_sum + block_cumsum
-
-            candidates_mask = total_cumsum > target_u
-            has_match = tl.max(candidates_mask, axis=0)
-
-            if has_match:
-                match_idx = tl.argmax(candidates_mask.to(tl.int32), axis=0)
-                final_token = v_start + match_idx
-                found = 1
-
-            cum_sum += tl.sum(val)
+    if tl.max(crossed.to(tl.int32), axis=0) > 0:
+        block = tl.argmax(crossed.to(tl.int32), axis=0)
+        cum_sum = tl.max(tl.where(blocks < block, block_cdf, 0.0), axis=0)
+        v_offsets = block * BLOCK_V + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_V)
+        val = _final_token_weights(

+            DraftProbs,
+            ResidualScale,
+            pid,
+            num_accept,
+            v_offsets,
+            stride_tp_b,
+            stride_tp_s,
+            stride_tp_v,
+            stride_dp_b,
+            stride_dp_s,
+            stride_dp_v,
+            NUM_SLOTS,
+            VOCAB_SIZE,
+        )

+        if tl.max(candidates_mask.to(tl.int32), axis=0) > 0:

+        else:

+            final_token = tl.max(tl.where(val > 0.0, v_offsets, 0), axis=0)
 
+    last_accepted_global_idx = tl.load(
+        RetriveIndex + pid * stride_idx_b + num_accept * stride_idx_s
+    )
     tl.store(Predicts + last_accepted_global_idx, final_token)
 
 
@@ -262,6 +354,14 @@ def chain_speculative_sampling_triton(
     # Keep CDF tiles small, and cap multi-tile reductions to avoid register spills.
     block_reduce = min(triton.next_power_of_2(vocab_size), 32768)
     num_warps = 8 if block_verification and block_reduce > 4096 else 4

+    residual_scale = torch.empty(
+        batch_size, dtype=torch.float32, device=target_probs.device
+    )
+    block_sums = torch.empty(

+    )
+    prob_strides = (*target_probs.stride(), *draft_probs.stride())
 
     grid = (batch_size,)
     speculative_sampling_classic_kernel[grid](
@@ -271,7 +371,7 @@ def chain_speculative_sampling_triton(
         candidates,
         retrive_index,
         uniform_samples,
-        uniform_samples_for_final_sampling,
+        residual_scale,
         target_probs,
         draft_probs,
         candidates.stride(0),
@@ -288,8 +388,41 @@ def chain_speculative_sampling_triton(
         draft_probs.stride(2),
         NUM_SLOTS=num_slots,
         VOCAB_SIZE=vocab_size,
-        BLOCK_V=4096,
         BLOCK_VERIFICATION=block_verification,
         BLOCK_REDUCE=block_reduce,
         num_warps=num_warps,
     )
+    # Final token: the block sums run over all (request, block) pairs in
+    # parallel, then one program per request searches a single block.
+    _final_token_block_sums_kernel[(batch_size, num_blocks)](
+        accept_token_num,
+        residual_scale,
+        target_probs,
+        draft_probs,
+        block_sums,
+        *prob_strides,
+        num_blocks,
+        NUM_SLOTS=num_slots,
+        VOCAB_SIZE=vocab_size,
+        BLOCK_V=_FINAL_BLOCK_V,
+        num_warps=8,
+    )
+    _final_token_kernel[grid](
+        predicts,
+        accept_token_num,
+        retrive_index,
+        uniform_samples_for_final_sampling,
+        residual_scale,
+        target_probs,
+        draft_probs,
+        block_sums,
+        retrive_index.stride(0),
+        retrive_index.stride(1),
+        *prob_strides,
+        num_blocks,
+        NUM_SLOTS=num_slots,
+        VOCAB_SIZE=vocab_size,
+        BLOCK_V=_FINAL_BLOCK_V,
+        NUM_BLOCKS_POW2=triton.next_power_of_2(num_blocks),
+        num_warps=8,
+    )
